data.full_form: South African Code for the Reporting of Exploration Results, Mineral Resources and Mineral Reserves
data.use_in_classification: The primary South African reporting standard; any tender or news item referencing 'SAMREC-compliant reporting' signals demand for Salaria-type services

data.full_form: South African Code for the Valuation of Mineral Assets
data.use_in_classification: Companion to SAMREC for mineral asset valuation; often referenced in M&A and JSE listing contexts

data.full_form: South African Code for the Reporting of Oil and Gas Resources
data.use_in_classification: Oil and gas equivalent of SAMREC; relevant if Salaria expands into petroleum resource reporting

data.full_form: Committee for Mineral Reserves International Reporting Standards
data.use_in_classification: International umbrella body for SAMREC, JORC, NI 43-101 etc.; cross-listing requirements referenced here
Formal independent technical report; mandatory for JSE listings and major transactions. A key deliverable Salaria produces
SACNASP- or ECSA-registered professional who signs off resource and reserve reports; must have 5+ years relevant experience
Canadian mineral reporting standard; referenced when a South African project has Canadian-listed shareholders or TSX aspirations

data.full_form: Joint Ore Reserves Committee Code (Australia/New Zealand)
data.use_in_classification: Australian equivalent of SAMREC; referenced for ASX-listed mining companies operating in South Africa

data.full_form: Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act 28 of 2002
data.use_in_classification: Primary mining rights legislation; tenders and contracts referencing MPRDA compliance indicate regulatory consulting scope

data.full_form: Mine Health and Safety Act 29 of 1996
data.use_in_classification: Governs on-site safety; rock engineering codes of practice, geotechnical reports for operating mines fall under MHSA requirements
Required for mining rights; often accompanied by feasibility and mine planning input from consultants like Salaria

data.full_form: Environmental Management Plan / Environmental Management Programme
data.use_in_classification: Required under MPRDA; geotechnical inputs to EMPs are a service adjacent to Salaria's core offering
Classification terms in resource statements; any tender or article using these terms signals resource estimation work
Reserve declaration triggers mine planning and feasibility deliverables; key signal of consulting demand
Project stages at which mine planning, geotechnical, and resource reporting services are most intensively required
Earliest formal project evaluation stage; often the entry point for consulting engagements

data.full_form: South African Mineral Resources Administration System
data.use_in_classification: Online DMRE portal for rights applications; monitoring new prospecting rights issued is a leading indicator of exploration consulting demand
Mandatory safety document for mines under MHSA; prepared or reviewed by rock engineering consultants
Empowerment scoring system that affects procurement eligibility for government and SOE tenders; critical compliance dimension for Salaria in public sector bids
Mandatory government supplier registration; required before any South African government tender can be awarded
